customers.evidence: We are committed to the highest standards of quality and service

employees.evidence: We are committed to making our partners proud and investing in their health, well-being and success

dei.evidence: creating a culture of belonging where everyone is welcome

community.evidence: We believe Starbucks can, and should, have a positive impact on the communities we serve.

innovation.evidence: embracing our heritage while innovating to create new experiences to savor

result.analyst_notes: Warm, first-person plural narrative that leads with heritage and origin story before stating values. Commitments use firm language ('We are committed to...', 'We believe...'). Partners (employees) and community/doing good receive the most developed treatment. Environment, integrity, safety and shareholders are essentially absent; profit is explicitly subordinated to purpose.
